projectDescription: A lightweight, type-safe, file-based configuration library for Java that stores typed key-value data — including POJOs and collections — in a URL-safe encoded flat format, with built-in support for encryption, transactions, caching, and custom type adapters.
keyFeatures: Type-safe key-value storage with automatic type tagging
File-based persistence using a compact URL-safe encoded format (JConfig001)
In-memory configuration mode for testing or ephemeral data
FlatJson converter alternative for JSON-based storage
ACID-style transactions with BeginTransaction / Commit / Rollback
Built-in read/write cache with configurable flush thresholds
POJO serialization via Jackson (SetPOJO / get with Class<T>)
Collection support (List, Map, etc.) via TypeReference
Pluggable TypeConverterAdapter interface for custom type registration
Regex-based key querying and pattern filtering
Zero mandatory external dependencies beyond Jackson (pure Java 19)
publicApiSurface: JungleConfig.Set(String key, Object data, String type)
JungleConfig.query(boolean iKey, String keyReg, boolean iType, String typeReg, boolean iVal, String valReg)
NativeTypeConverter(CacheInterface manager, boolean fallback, TypeConverterAdapter... adapters)
TypeMap<T,D,S> — ordered triple-entry map used for query results
